name: Salvinorin B ethoxymethyl ether
summary: Salvinorin B ethoxymethyl ether (EOM-salB, symmetry) is a κ-opioid receptor agonist and semi-synthetic analogue of the natural product salvinorin A, the psychoactive compound in Salvia divinorum. It has greatly increased potency compared to salvinorin A and can show a longer duration of action, depending on the route of administration.

pharmacology.text: EOM-salB has an affinity (Ki) of 0.32 nM at the κ-opioid receptor, and around 3,000 times selectivity over the μ- and δ-opioid receptors, making it one of the most potent and selective κ-opioid receptor agonists yet discovered.

uses.text: It has been sold online as an analytical standard since at least 2023.

sideEffects.en: Effects come on fast and can be overwhelming, with loss of touch with surroundings, falls and injuries, confusion, fear and sometimes lasting distress. Driving or being near hazards while affected is dangerous.
sideEffects.zh: 效果來得很快，可能強烈到難以承受，包括與周遭環境失去聯繫、跌倒受傷、意識混亂、恐懼，有時還有持續的不適感。在藥效期間開車或靠近危險物是危險的。
sideEffects.zhHans: 效果来得很快，可能强烈到难以承受，包括与周遭环境失去联系、跌倒受伤、意识混乱、恐惧，有时还有持续的不适感。在药效期间开车或靠近危险物是危险的。

fact.en: Salvinorin A carries an acetate group that the body removes quickly. Replacing it with an ether, as here, makes the molecule last longer because enzymes cannot clip an ether off so easily.
fact.zh: 沙維諾林 A 帶有一個會被人體迅速移除的乙酸酯基。像這裡一樣改成醚類後，分子作用更持久，因為酵素不容易把醚切斷。
fact.zhHans: 沙维诺林 A 带有一个会被人体迅速移除的乙酸酯基。像这里一样改成醚类后，分子作用更持久，因为酵素不容易把醚切断。
